## Load Data

```{r}
speed <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/roualdes/data/master/speed.csv")
tail(speed)
```

## Plotting

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
ggplot(
  data = speed,
  aes(year, mips / cores)
) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
sd(speed$mips)
```
